comparison.objective: Pry a press-fit paint-tin lid free and place it safely; candidate sets and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Insert a screwdriver into a rim groove, lever successive lid regions, and reorient the tin; no simultaneous wrench/driver countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Scores partial lid release, full removal, safe orientation, placement, and release; candidate scores angular accuracy and retained function after locking.
comparison.reason: Tool use is shared, but distributed prying of a lid tests a different contact mechanism and outcome from preserving a threaded adjustment.
